1086-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1086-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4677-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
4677-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 green Elemental creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

619-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1829-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1829-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

985-5078-6791-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

64-277-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
64-277-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
64-277-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Warden of the Eye and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1479-2841-4488-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-4488-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-856-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
728-856-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
728-856-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
728-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat
728-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-3478-7885.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2976-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

792-1580-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3398-7067.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-7067.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Fire Nation Turret triggers, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 2 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its innate ability and each instance of firebending it has.
Resolve all firebending triggers, adding {R}{R} for each trigger.
Resolve the other Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3398-7067.notes: Each loop will add {R}{R} more than the previous loop. Excess mana can be poured into Fire Nation Turret and then removed for damage.

924-1879-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-1879-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-1879-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-1879-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

856-5226-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

3617-4477-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and exiling Ephemerate.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-3259-4742-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-4742-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-4742-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

301-1099-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
301-1099-7096.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

4659-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3525-3574-7061.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3525-3574-7061.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-7061.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5231-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5231-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and without summoning sickness

3995-4613-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Steelswarm Operator using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3995-4613-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

1661-1836-4423-6618.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1661-1836-4423-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Relm's Sketching from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Activate the original Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 4.

1170-1645-2499-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1799-4659-5359-5496.description:
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

803-1429-4659-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-4659-5402.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

372-3277-3603.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-3277-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

132-4131-4893.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Slimefoot and Squee does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
222-1849-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slimefoot and Squee as attackers.
Slimefoot and Squee triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2796-4594.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat.

1692-4251.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Godo.
1692-4251.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Godo with haste.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker.
The token Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2583-3484-4636.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Thopter token enters the battlefield, triggering Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart's trigger, adding {E}{E}.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, adding {E}.
Repeat.
